meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里当前可用的本地模型,以及把提示词发给指定模型并取回回答。Claude 仍是主调度者,只是把任务分给本地模型跑。
howto.when: 当你想让本地 Atomic Chat 里运行的模型来回答或干活时(比如说“用 atomic chat……”或点名某个模型),Claude 会接管并调用这些工具。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: Claude 先列模型,再生成回答

say.text: 先用 atomic chat 列出现在有哪些可用模型

howto.what_en: Claude gains two tools: listing the local models available in the Atomic Chat desktop app, and sending a prompt to a chosen model to get its reply. Claude stays the orchestrator and offloads work to local models.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a model running in Atomic Chat to answer or do the work — for example when you say "use atomic chat" or name a specific local model.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
Use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: ...
List the models currently available in atomic chat first
